description.p: A fast Fastmail client built on JMAP, GTK 4 and libadwaita. A local cache makes folder switches instant and keeps mail readable offline; changes arrive by push.

Labels with drag and drop, undo for every action including sending, sanitised HTML with remote content held back, identities and Masked Email, search operators, sorting and grouping by sender, local categories, sidebar views such as Newsletters and Never read, a cleanup dialog that ranks senders and archives, deletes or unsubscribes in bulk, rules, and a screener for first-time senders.

description.p: Preferences in the order they are needed, with search; summaries on request for opened or new mail; a short tour and a guide with a page per topic; fewer requests to the server; quieter message views; a remote-content notice that fits.

Label and category colours are back, with a switch; cards are visible in dark mode; the tip, the summary and the quick links follow the GNOME guidelines; the version shows in the app; icon buttons have accessible names; shorter texts throughout; an Advanced row in Preferences; a refreshed tour.
A click on a new-mail notification opens that message; PINs work again and the keyring choice can be backed out of; shorter preference texts.

Drafts saved offline are kept and created with the next sync; a third way to unlock, through a Den Mail keyring; sender logos with a choice of where they come from; label suggestions learned from labelled mail; the app can keep running in the background for notifications; the hints above the list can be closed; the rules say plainly that they run in the app.

An assistant, off by default: Ollama on this machine, any OpenAI-compatible API or Anthropic, with the key in the keyring and a daily request limit. With it on, a conversation can be summarised in a few lines, and Clean up describes a sender's newest message in one line.

Send later with a clock next to Send; an offline outbox that queues changes and messages while the server is unreachable; a lock screen, off by default, unlocked with the system prompt, a passphrase or a PIN; schema.org data in mail summarised above the body.
A Flatpak bundle with every release and an AUR package; corrections that the app learns from; the Fastmail address book for completion and contact photos; the UI run headlessly in CI.
Sidebar views, rules, the cleanup dialog, the screener for first-time senders, Preferences on three pages, and tips.
